header: Cards that name an audience and link to its page
lead: The hub of a set of pages rather than the argument itself. Each card names a job or a sector and sends the reader somewhere that can afford the detail.

cases.title: The whole card is the link
cases.description: One tab stop per card, and the title carries the accessible name.

cases.title: The description stays short
cases.description: Two lines at most, because the page behind the card is where the argument belongs.

cases.title: Two to four columns
cases.description: Same grid as the feature band, so a page using both keeps one rhythm.

cases.title: A browse-all action
cases.description: For the set that outgrew nine cards and became a directory.
